theorems.name: Survival Probability at Maturity
theorems.description: Under constant hazard rate h, the survival probability at T = t equals 1: S(T, T) = 1.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.Credit

open MathFin

theorem survival_at_zero_thm (h T : ℝ) :
    MathFin.survivalProbability h T T = 1 :=
  MathFin.survival_at_zero h T

theorems.name: Credit Spread Equals Hazard Under Constant Hazard
theorems.description: Under constant hazard rate h, the credit spread -log(S)/(T-t) equals h. Structurally identical to ZCB yield equality under flat rate.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.Credit

open MathFin

theorem credit_spread_eq_hazard_thm {h t T : ℝ} (htT : t < T) :
    -Real.log (MathFin.survivalProbability h t T) / (T - t) = h :=
  MathFin.creditSpread_eq_hazard htT

theorems.name: First-to-Default Spread Is the Sum of Single-Name Hazards
theorems.description: For a basket of jointly independent exponential default times τ_i ~ Exp(rates i), the first-to-default credit spread — read off the measure of the basket survival event, −log μ(min_i τ_i > t)/t for t > 0 — equals Σ rates: basket intensity is the sum of single-name intensities, so FtD spreads are additive under independence. Dependent default times are not treated.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.FirstToDefault

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory MathFin

theorem first_to_default_spread_thm
    {Ω : Type*} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω}
    {n : ℕ} {rates : Fin n → ℝ} {τ : Fin n → Ω → ℝ}
    (hrates_pos : ∀ i, 0 < rates i)
    (hexp_law : ∀ i, Measure.map (τ i) μ = expMeasure (rates i))
    (hindep : iIndepFun τ μ)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (τ i))
    (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    -Real.log ((μ {ω | t < Finset.univ.inf' ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        (fun i : Fin n => τ i ω)}).toReal) / t
      = ∑ i, rates i :=
  MathFin.firstToDefault_spread_eq_sum_hazards hrates_pos hexp_law hindep hmeas hn ht

metadata.reference: First-to-default baskets under independent reduced-form intensities (Lando 2004 Ch 5; Duffie-Singleton 2003)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof: Foundations/ExpMin.minimum_survival (minimum of jointly independent exponentials survives at the summed rate) bridged into the Credit.lean vocabulary — the basket survival probability IS survivalProbability (Σ rates) 0 t (firstToDefault_survival), and the spread reading follows by creditSpread_eq_hazard. Lives in MathFin/FixedIncome/FirstToDefault.lean. Axioms-clean.

theorems.name: Time-Varying Hazard Survival Reduces to Constant Form
theorems.description: When the hazard function is constant h(u) ≡ h₀, the cumulative hazard ∫₀^t h₀ du = h₀·t and the survival probability exp(-cumHazard) matches the constant-hazard formula exp(-h₀(T-t)) at t=0.

theorems.name: Credit Spread as Time-Averaged Hazard
theorems.description: Under time-varying hazard h(u), the credit spread c(T) = -log(S(T))/T = H(T)/T where H is the cumulative hazard. The spread is the time-averaged hazard.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.HazardCurve

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open scoped NNReal
open MathFin

/-- **Credit spread = time-averaged hazard** — definitional given
    `S := exp(−H)` (`Real.log_exp`); paired below with the substantive FTC
    recovery that grounds the model. -/
theorem creditSpread_eq_time_avg_hazard_thm {h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    -Real.log (MathFin.hazardSurvival h T) / T = MathFin.cumHazard h T / T :=
  MathFin.creditSpread_eq_time_avg_hazard hT

/-- **Hazard recovered from the survival curve** (the substantive direction):
    `h(t) = −d/dt log S(t)` for continuous `h`, by the FTC through the
    `ExponentialDiscount` principle. -/
theorem hazard_recovers_from_survival_thm {h : ℝ → ℝ} (t : ℝ)
    (hh : Continuous h) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => -(Real.log (MathFin.hazardSurvival h s))) (h t) t :=
  MathFin.hazard_eq_neg_log_deriv_survival t hh

metadata.reference: Hazard curve and credit spread (Lando, Credit Risk Modeling)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. The snippet exports both directions honestly split: the spread identity −log S(T)/T = H(T)/T is definitional given S := exp(−H) (Real.log_exp), and the substantive content is the FTC recovery hazard_eq_neg_log_deriv_survival (h(t) = −d/dt log S(t) for continuous h), also exported. Axioms-clean.

theorems.name: KMV-Merton risk-neutral probability of default = Q(V_T ≤ F)
theorems.description: Under the Merton structural model with the firm value's risk-neutral law (BSCallHyp), the KMV default probability kmvPD equals the actual risk-neutral default probability 1 − Q({V_T > F}) — the genuine probabilistic content (via the BS risk-neutral exercise probability), not the algebraic Φ-symmetry identity.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.KMVMertonStructural

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open MathFin

theorem kmv_pd_eq_risk_neutral_default_thm
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V_0) (hF : 0 < F) (h : MathFin.BSCallHyp Q V_0 F r σ_V T Z) :
    MathFin.kmvPD V_0 F r σ_V T =
      1 - (Q {ω | MathFin.bsTerminal V_0 r σ_V T (Z ω) > F}).toReal :=
  MathFin.kmvPD_eq_one_sub_survival_probability hV hF h

metadata.reference: Merton 1974 structural credit; KMV (Moody's) commercial implementation
metadata.formalization_scope: Full derivation: kmvPD = 1 − Q({V_T > F}) via MathFin.kmvPD_eq_one_sub_survival_probability, which routes through riskNeutralProb_S_T_gt_K (the genuine BS risk-neutral exercise probability). Axioms-clean.

theorems.name: KMV-Merton Survival Probability = Φ(d_2^KMV)
theorems.description: The probabilistic survival statement of the KMV–Merton model: under risk-neutral lognormal firm-value dynamics, Q({V_T > F}).toReal = Φ(DD) — the measure of the no-default event equals the standard-normal CDF of the distance to default (survival_probability_eq_Phi_distanceToDefault), routed through the lognormal tail computation riskNeutralProb_S_T_gt_K and kmvDistanceToDefault_eq_bsd2.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.KMVMertonStructural

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open MathFin

theorem kmv_survival_probability_eq_Phi_dd_thm
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V_0) (hF : 0 < F) (h : MathFin.BSCallHyp Q V_0 F r σ_V T Z) :
    (Q {ω | MathFin.bsTerminal V_0 r σ_V T (Z ω) > F}).toReal =
      Phi (MathFin.kmvDistanceToDefault V_0 F r σ_V T) :=
  MathFin.survival_probability_eq_Phi_distanceToDefault hV hF h

metadata.formalization_scope: Full derivation (upgraded-properly 2026-06-04): the genuinely probabilistic survival statement Q({V_T > F}).toReal = Phi(distance-to-default), via MathFin.survival_probability_eq_Phi_distanceToDefault, which routes the no-default event's measure through riskNeutralProb_S_T_gt_K (the lognormal tail computation) and kmvDistanceToDefault_eq_bsd2. Replaces the former algebraic CDF-symmetry shadow (1 - Phi(-DD) = Phi(DD)). Complements mf-kmv-merton-pd (the PD identification) on the survival side. Axioms-clean.

theorems.name: CDS Fair Spread: c = h · (1 − R)
theorems.description: Under constant hazard h with recovery R, the fair CDS spread c = h · (1 − R), via leg equality.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.Credit

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open scoped NNReal
open MathFin

theorem cds_leg_equality_thm (h R factor c : ℝ) (h_factor_ne : factor ≠ 0) :
    c * factor = (1 - R) * h * factor ↔ c = MathFin.cdsFairSpread h R :=
  MathFin.cds_leg_equality h R factor c h_factor_ne

metadata.reference: CDS pricing under constant hazard with recovery (Jarrow-Turnbull)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof of the iff-characterisation c·factor = (1−R)·h·factor ⟺ c = (1−R)·h. `factor` is an abstract common annuity factor (both legs proportional to the same factor); the closed-form annuity computation (1−e^{−(r+h)T})/(r+h) is module prose, not Lean. Re-export from MathFin. Axioms-clean.
